name: AE Employer Election Drill-Down
description: Per-employer 2026 vs 2027 Annual Enrollment comparison. Meant to sit beside a native SAC Input Control (bound to Employer_Name via Linked Analysis): with no employer selected, shows a needs-attention list sorted by size and completion; with one selected, shows a full year-over-year comparison card.

feeds.description: Employer_Name / Synod_Region / Eligible_Band / Enrollment_Status / Status_2026 / Contribution_Set / Contribution_Set_2026 / Health_Plan_Bundle, from AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_DETAIL (built directly on GLD_AE_Employer_Enrollment -- GLD_AE_Employer_Enrollment_YoY and AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_YOY were retired 2026-09-16 once their columns were merged into Gold). Status_2026 uses a different, unreconciled vocabulary than Enrollment_Status -- shown as-is, not mapped; still open how to source that same vocabulary for the current cycle. Bind this widget's model, then filter it via a native Input Control on Employer_Name (Tools -> Link Dimensions) -- no selection shows a needs-attention list, one selection shows a full comparison card.

Employee_Count, Employee_Count_2026, Eligible_Count_2027, HSA_Single, HSA_Family, HSA_One_Time_Single, HSA_One_Time_Family, HSA_Single_2026, HSA_Family_2026, HSA_One_Time_Single_2026, HSA_One_Time_Family_2026 -- in that exact order

refresh.description: Re-renders the widget from the currently bound data
